lines.text: Believers can enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus and draw near with a sincere heart.
Believers have a great king over the house of God and are told to hold resolutely to their hope.
The writer says to spur one another on to love and good deeds and not neglect meeting together.
Anyone who rejected the law of Abraham died without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
The righteous one will live by faith, and the writer says they are of those who preserve their souls.
